definitions.gloss: side of the abdomen; flank; side of the body
definitions.explanation: The area on the side of the torso, between the ribs and the hip.

definitions.gloss: side; flank (of an object or vehicle)
definitions.explanation: The side surface of something, by extension from the body part.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}ると{横腹|よこばら}が{痛|いた}くなる。
examples.english: My side hurts when I run.

examples.japanese: {横腹|よこばら}をつねられた。
examples.english: I was pinched in the side.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}{中|ちゅう}に{横腹|よこばら}が{痛|いた}くなったら、{深呼吸|しんこきゅう}をして{少|すこ}し{休|やす}むといい。
examples.english: If you get a side stitch during exercise, take some deep breaths and rest a bit.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{横腹|よこばら}にぶつけられた。
examples.english: The car was hit in the side.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}の{横腹|よこばら}に{大|おお}きな{穴|あな}が{開|あ}いた。
examples.english: A large hole opened in the side of the ship.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{横腹|よこばら}にトンネルが{掘|ほ}られている。
examples.english: A tunnel has been dug into the side of the mountain.

notes:
Compound of {横|よこ} (side) + {腹|はら}/{腹|ばら} (belly/abdomen). The reading uses rendaku ({腹|ばら}). Most commonly heard in the context of side stitches during running.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横腹|よこばら}が{痛|いた}い: my side hurts
- {横腹|よこばら}を{押|お}さえる: to hold one's side

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脇腹|わきばら}: side of the abdomen (very close synonym, slightly more common)
- {横|よこ}: side (general)
- {側面|そくめん}: side surface (more formal/technical)
